description: Generic import profiles for salary survey and practice survey files (docs/19 §6.2). A tenant imports its own licensed copy of a survey; nothing here contains survey data. A profile says what each column means; the import wizard proposes a profile from the headers and the analyst confirms or adjusts it before a dry run.

sti_target_pct.fr: Cible de prime à court terme (% du salaire)

sti_actual_pct.fr: Prime à court terme versée (% du salaire)

sti_eligible.fr: Proportion admissible aux primes à court terme

total_cash.fr: Rémunération totale en espèces (salaire et prime versée)

weightings.organization: Each organization counts once (its average for the job); describes what organizations pay
weightings.incumbent: Each incumbent counts once; describes what people are paid and leans toward large employers
weightings.single: The file has only one weighting

parsing.numbers: Accept 65000, 65,000, $65,000, 65 000 $ and 65 000,50 (fr-CA, with a space, no-break space or narrow no-break space as the thousands separator and a comma as the decimal mark). The locale is chosen per file in the wizard; a file never mixes locales.
parsing.percent: Accept 12.5, 12.5% and 0.125 when the column is marked as a fraction.
parsing.store: Amounts are stored as numeric(14,4) in the edition's currency; masked or blank values are stored as null and listed in masked_fields. Nothing is ever imputed.

profiles.name_en: One row per job, cut and weighting
profiles.name_fr: Une ligne par emploi, découpage et pondération

profiles.name_en: One row per job, cut, weighting and element
profiles.name_fr: Une ligne par emploi, découpage, pondération et élément

profiles.loads_into: core.code_value of the survey's code scheme (docs/18 §3.3), so survey matches are ordinary code assignments

description.note: Licensed text; stored for the tenant only and shown only to roles the survey's licence allows

criteria.note: Optional JSON, e.g. {"fteMin": 100, "fteMax": 250} or {"province": "BC"}; used to suggest the cut that fits the tenant

profiles.name_fr: Prévalence des avantages et des pratiques

practice_code.note: The survey's question code; the wizard maps it to a catalogue practice (rules/total-rewards/benefit-practices.json) or a tenant practice

distribution.note: Optional JSON of value to share, e.g. {"2": 40, "3": 35, "4": 25} for vacation weeks

errors.text_en: The job code is not in this edition's job catalogue.
Two rows have the same job, cut, weighting and element.
Percentiles must not decrease from P10 to P90.
Counts and amounts cannot be negative.
The value is not a number and is not a masking mark.
The cut code is not in the cut dictionary.

warnings.text_en: A statistic is shown with fewer data points than the edition's published masking rule. Check the file.
The mean is outside P10 to P90.
Hourly rate times the edition's annual hours differs from base salary by more than 15%.
The P50 changed by more than 25% from the previous edition for the same job and cut.
